name: DMX Input Plugin for FPP
author: joeskolengaden
description: Reads a DMX-512 universe from a UART configured as receive (RS-485 RO wired to a BeagleBone Tx/Rx-capable pin, e.g. WL8/WL16/WL24 DMX2 port with DE/RE jumpered to GND) and injects it into FPP's live channel data as bridge data, same as the built-in E1.31/ArtNet/DDP inputs.
